# Skillchip Station
The skillchip station is a neural interface chair that fits and pulls skillchips for whoever is sitting in it. It is the only way to get a chip into or out of a brain.
## Building one It is a standard machine: build a machine frame, drop in the circuit board, and add the parts.
The board is printed at a circuit imprinter once the [color=#a4885c]Skill Implantation[/color] node has been researched, which lives in the service side of the research tree.
## Using it 1. Drag the patient onto the chair to seat them. They stay put until the work is done.\n2. Put a skillchip in the tray by clicking the chip on the station with it in hand.\n3. Open the station's interface and press [color=#a4885c]Implant[/color]. The procedure takes 15 seconds and the chip is used up.
To pull a chip, open the interface with the patient seated and press [color=#a4885c]Remove[/color] next to the chip you want out. Removal also takes 15 seconds, and the chip is [color=#993333]destroyed in the process[/color], you do not get it back.
The interface shows the chip in the tray (its name, what it does, and its capacity cost), every chip already in the seated patient's brain, and a capacity bar for that patient. With nobody seated there is nothing to act on.
